_notes.purpose: Static dummy story content for 4 genres, used as the fixed story-engine content per the updated PRD (story beats are no longer generated fresh per session — this file is the source of truth for POST /story/beat).
_notes.supersedes: dummy_stories.json (old shape: single-select, trip_type/pace/food_preference/flavor_preference treated as raw trip-state fields). This file matches the shape actually implemented in story_flow_frontend plan: multi-select choices, no budget/diet collection, food_preference/flavor_preference feed a holiday profile rather than being stored as literal budget/diet.
_notes.note_on_field_naming: food_style and wildcard_flavor are stored on TripState.food_preference and TripState.flavor_preference columns respectively (no schema migration), but are NEVER treated as budget or dietary-restriction fields in the itinerary brief. The orchestrator states explicitly that budget and diet were not collected for the story path.
_notes.schema_alignment: Mirrors story_sessions.beats: beat_number, narrative_text, audio_url, field, options[{label, value, image_url}], chosen_value. chosen_value is a LIST of values (multi-select), populated at runtime from user picks — not stored here.
_notes.after_beat_5: Beat 5 is followed by a generated holiday profile (six short phrases + assumptions), not a 6th beat. Profile generation is a separate agent call, still using dest/dates from trip_state; it is out of scope for this dummy file.
_notes.generated_as: Dummy/static content, not model-generated. This is the fixed content used in production for v1 — see PRD Section 8 update: fresh per-session generation is no longer in scope.

beats.narrative_text: The portal to {{destination}} hums with pale light. A robed gatekeeper steps forward, staff tapping the stone floor. 'State your company, traveler — who crosses the threshold with you? Speak all that apply.'

options.label: I walk this path alone
My partner and I, hand in hand
A fellowship of friends
My kin, with our loyal hound at heel

beats.narrative_text: Beyond the gate, roads fork through the realm of {{destination}}. The gatekeeper watches to see which call to you — you may follow more than one.

options.label: The road to ancient towers and monuments
The road to feasting halls and market stalls
The road to untamed wilds and adventure
The road to old libraries and forgotten lore

beats.narrative_text: A weathered mapmaker offers to chart your journey. 'How shall we ride, traveler? Name every pace that suits you.'

options.label: Slowly — let the land reveal itself
At a steady, even gallop
Full speed, banner to the wind
Wherever the wind carries us

beats.narrative_text: Smoke curls from a tavern hearth ahead. The innkeeper calls out, ladle in hand. 'What fare suits a traveler such as yourself? Choose as many as tempt you.'

options.label: The realm's own hearty, traditional fare
Whatever strange delicacy the cook dares serve
A feast fit for a lord's table
Something warm and familiar

beats.narrative_text: The mapmaker rolls up the last of the parchment. 'One final question, before the road takes you — what shape does your journey favor? Mark all that ring true.'

options.label: A course charted true, step by step
An open road, fate deciding the rest
The hidden paths few travelers find
The great, storied landmarks of legend

beats.narrative_text: A telegram arrives, ink still damp: 'Come to {{destination}} at once.' The station platform is nearly empty. A figure in a grey coat waits by the ticket booth. 'Who's working this case with you? Name them all.'

options.label: Just me and my notebook
My partner in crime-solving
A small circle of trusted friends
The whole family, plus the family dog

beats.narrative_text: The grey-coated figure slides a folder across the counter — leads scattered across {{destination}}. 'Which threads do we pull? Pick as many as you like.'

options.label: The landmark where the witness was last seen
The café where the informants gather
The docks — dangerous, but promising
The archive holding the case's history

beats.narrative_text: A clock ticks somewhere unseen. Time is a variable in this case — how do you want to work it? Choose every pace that fits.

options.label: Careful, deliberate, no detail missed
A steady, methodical pace
Racing the clock, lead to lead
Following instinct wherever it points

beats.narrative_text: A waiter slides a menu across a rain-streaked table, low light flickering above. 'The usual, or something else tonight?' Order as much as you're curious about.

options.label: The house specialty — locals swear by it
Whatever's unusual on tonight's menu
Something upscale — this is a good table
Something familiar, to steady the nerves

beats.narrative_text: The grey-coated figure taps ash from a cigarette. 'Last thing — how do detectives like you tend to work? Mark every style that's true.'

options.label: Always a plan — every angle covered
I improvise — the case rewrites itself anyway
I follow the leads no one else notices
I start with the obvious suspects — the landmarks

beats.narrative_text: The shuttle's cabin lights flicker as {{destination}} rotates into view through the viewport. The onboard AI chimes softly. 'Manifest check — who's on this transport with you? List everyone.'

options.label: Solo passenger, manifest of one
My co-pilot and me
A crew of close friends
Family unit, plus one bio-companion (pet)

beats.narrative_text: The AI projects a holographic map of {{destination}}, its sectors glowing. 'Select sectors for reconnaissance — multiple selections permitted.'

options.label: The observation towers and skyline
The nutrient bazaar and food synth district
The unmapped outer perimeter
The archive core and history banks

beats.narrative_text: 'Setting transit velocity,' the AI announces. 'How should I calibrate our exploration speed? You may select more than one profile.'

options.label: Low velocity — full sensor sweep
Standard cruising speed
Maximum thrust, sector to sector
Adaptive — recalculate as we go

beats.narrative_text: A nutrient dispenser hums to life in the galley. 'Ration protocol requested. Specify all acceptable preferences.'

options.label: Native cuisine, unmodified
Experimental synth-dishes, unknown flavor profiles
Premium replicated tasting menu
Standard comfort rations

beats.narrative_text: The AI's core light pulses once. 'Final parameter: how should navigation behave? Select every mode you'd accept.'

options.label: Lock the flight path — precision matters
Leave it open — let the mission adapt
Chart the unlisted, unregistered coordinates
Prioritize the recognized landmark beacons

beats.narrative_text: Dust settles as the stagecoach rolls into {{destination}}. The sheriff leans against the saloon post, thumbs in his belt. 'Who's ridin' with you, stranger? Name 'em all.'

options.label: Just me and my horse
Me and my partner
A posse of good friends
The whole family, dog included

beats.narrative_text: The sheriff nods toward the roads leading out of town. 'Which way you headed? Pick as many trails as you please.'

options.label: Up to the old lookout point
Down to the saloon and chuckwagon row
Out toward the canyon trails
Over to the old town museum

beats.narrative_text: The stable hand saddles up. 'How hard you wanna ride, partner? Tell me every gait you're good with.'

options.label: Slow trot, take in the scenery
Steady, even pace
Full gallop, sunup to sundown
However the trail takes us

beats.narrative_text: The chuckwagon cook bangs a ladle on the pot. 'What'll it be, stranger? Load up your plate with whatever suits.'

options.label: The old ranch classics
Whatever's cookin' that I ain't tried
The good stuff, saved for payday
Somethin' simple and hearty

beats.narrative_text: The sheriff tips his hat as you mount up. 'One last thing — how do you like to ride into the unknown? Mark every way that's true to you.'

options.label: A plan, mapped out proper
Let the trail decide
The trails most folks don't ride
The landmarks this town's known for
